turnos.t: Unit 1.1. A perspective is how a particular situation is viewed and understood by an individual, based on a mix of personal and collective assumptions, values and beliefs.
And a worldview is the group version?

Exactly. A worldview is the perspectives and values shared by a group of people, through which they perceive, make sense of and act within their environment. And one trap: a perspective is not an argument. The argument is the reasoning and evidence you use to support or challenge a perspective.
